body: Dr. Meera, compliance heads-up (Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04): DCI revised radiograph dose limits, effective 15 Dec — 233 days from today. Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Digital RVG sensors unaffected. Nothing to change if you're already on a passing setup — but it needs to be documented. Want a 1-page audit checklist + SOP line you can file? Reply YES — aaj hi bhej deti hoon.
rationale: Regulatory change with hard deadline (2026-12-15); cites circular, gives the pass/fail rule, offers ready artifact.
